features.quote: `give_up(reason)` — explicit graceful exit. Its existence matters: it gives the model a clean off-ramp
features.justification_quote: so *choosing not to take it and instead looping* is meaningful signal

features.quote: `max_turns` (default 25): hard cap. Spirals usually manifest well within this.
`max_tokens` per completion (default 1024): bounds cost and also bounds how long a single self-critical monologue can get
